bookings_policy_snapshot_pair.name: bookings_policy_snapshot_pair
bookings_policy_snapshot_pair.value: ("bookings"."policy_snapshot" IS NULL) = ("bookings"."policy_text" IS NULL) AND ("bookings"."policy_snapshot" IS NULL) = ("bookings"."policy_hash" IS NULL)

mercadopago_connections_tokens_match_sta.name: mercadopago_connections_tokens_match_status
mercadopago_connections_tokens_match_sta.value:
(
    ("mercadopago_connections"."status" = 'connected' AND "mercadopago_connections"."disconnected_at" IS NULL AND "mercadopago_connections"."access_token_enc" IS NOT NULL AND "mercadopago_connections"."refresh_token_enc" IS NOT NULL AND length("mercadopago_connections"."access_token_enc") > 0 AND length("mercadopago_connections"."refresh_token_enc") > 0 AND "mercadopago_connections"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL)
    OR ("mercadopago_connections"."status" = 'needs_reconnect' AND "mercadopago_connections"."access_token_enc" IS NULL AND "mercadopago_connections"."refresh_token_enc" IS NULL)
    OR ("mercadopago_connections"."status" = 'disconnected' AND "mercadopago_connections"."disconnected_at" IS NOT NULL AND (
      ("mercadopago_connections"."access_token_enc" IS NULL AND "mercadopago_connections"."refresh_token_enc" IS NULL)
      OR ("mercadopago_connections"."access_token_enc" IS NOT NULL AND "mercadopago_connections"."refresh_token_enc" IS NOT NULL AND length("mercadopago_connections"."access_token_enc") > 0 AND length("mercadopago_connections"."refresh_token_enc") > 0)
    ))
  )

payments_remote_cancel_due_idx.name: payments_remote_cancel_due_idx
payments_remote_cancel_due_idx.where: "payments"."remote_cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "payments"."external_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."status" IN ('pending', 'expired')

payments_creating_has_no_qr.name: payments_creating_has_no_qr
payments_creating_has_no_qr.value: "payments"."status" <> 'creating' OR ("payments"."qr_code_data_url" IS NULL AND "payments"."copy_paste" IS NULL AND "payments"."external_id" IS NULL)

payments_pending_has_qr.name: payments_pending_has_qr
payments_pending_has_qr.value: "payments"."status" <> 'pending' OR ("payments"."external_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."qr_code_data_url" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."copy_paste" IS NOT NULL)

payments_refunded_timestamp_required.name: payments_refunded_timestamp_required
payments_refunded_timestamp_required.value: "payments"."refund_status" IS DISTINCT FROM 'refunded' OR "payments"."refunded_at" IS NOT NULL
